layout_and_spacing.card_style: flat background, 1px border-border, no shadow, sharp corners

components.header: Sticky nav with crystal glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`), 1px white/10 bottom border. High-contrast typography.
components.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large Display heading. Search input for 'True Verdict' takes center stage. Use `image_urls.hero_bg` with heavy black/60 overlay to ensure text contrast.
components.car_comparison: Split-pane bento box. 1px borders (`border-border`). On AI verdict, animate an amber glow (`shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]`).
components.ai_chat: Terminal/Futuristic look. Pure black background (`#000000`). User messages in muted surface color. AI messages highlighted with amber left-border (`border-l-2 border-primary`).
components.emi_calculator: Minimalist sliders (Shadcn customized). Track in dark gray, thumb in amber. Large data typography for EMI value (`text-5xl font-light`).
components.buttons: Sharp corners. Primary: `bg-primary text-black hover:bg-primary_hover`. Secondary: `border border-white/20 bg-transparent hover:bg-white/5`.
components.forms: Inputs use Shadcn but customized: `bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 rounded-none focus:border-primary`.

motion.hover: Subtle border color change and -translate-y-1. Do not use scale transformations on large cards.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for bento grid items.

hero_bg.description: Dark blue SUV parked in a studio with spotlights, perfect for cinematic hero background with an overlay.

ai_abstract.description: Abstract metallic wave pattern representing AI data flow.

car_thar.description: Mahindra Thar at sunset, for car database card.

car_hyundai.description: Front of a dark SUV, for comparison card.

dashboard_macro.description: Interior of car dashboard, for AI recommendation engine background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Google Fonts: 'Outfit' (for headings) and 'Manrope' (for body text).
Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT use Shadcn's default slate/zinc colors if they conflict with pure black (#050505) and surface (#111111).
Build a custom asymmetrical bento-grid for the car comparison section, avoiding standard equal-width columns.
The hero section MUST use 'image_urls.hero_bg' with a heavy black overlay (e.g. `bg-black/70`) to ensure the 'True Verdict' search bar pops.
Use 1px sharp borders (`border-[#262626]`) and square corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` at max) to maintain the premium, high-tech 'Obsidian Trust' aesthetic.
The AI Chat UI should look like a high-end command center, not a standard iMessage clone. Use terminal-like aesthetics with amber accents.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='compare-cars-btn'`).
Implement the EMI calculator using Shadcn Slider but override styles to match the dark amber theme.
